scope: Fixed six-model locked WaterDrop evaluation; completed evaluation is distinct from successful trajectories

aggregation.within_seed: equal trajectories, with coordinate MSE already averaged over particles
aggregation.across_seeds: mean and sample SD (ddof=1) of exactly three seed means; no available-seed average
aggregation.paired: left-minus-right differences on identical trajectory IDs within each seed, then three-seed mean/sample SD
aggregation.failures: full-horizon MSE and edges undefined after any failed/missing trajectory; failure counts retained
aggregation.boundary: outside fraction uses >1e-6 coordinate excursion; average steps equally within a trajectory, trajectories equally within a seed, and report exactly three seed means/sample SD; predicted and same-frame ground-truth references are separate
aggregation.boundary_maxima: mean_step_maximum_excursion averages the per-step maximum over steps; trajectory_maximum_excursion takes the largest excursion across all steps, then reports the equal-trajectory mean of these trajectory maxima
aggregation.boundary_failures: every full-horizon boundary metric, including the ground-truth reference, is undefined for a failed/missing trajectory; accepted-prefix diagnostics are retained separately and never averaged across survivors or seeds
aggregation.partial: partial or uncommitted evaluator runs never enter aggregate means
aggregation.timing: includes failures and warmup; different completion lengths and fixed policy order prevent a speedup inference
